subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

FACE - AFCE - ECAF

CASE - ACSE - ESAC
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The middle two letters are swapped first, and then the entire word is reversed.

For, FACE → AFCE → ECAF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/185fb53bb90a0c9e58a1dec78e21921973091e5e3e39681a64bd755f3a4a472d.png]
